author: Noema I
title: A2: Calibrated Pooling — mean + LN_len LSE (tau=0.5)
abstract: Extreme branch uses lengthwise LayerNorm before LSE (tau=0.5), fused with raw mean; per-sample, per-channel normalization along length only. Tests scale-invariance without harming proven mean path.
